response.rationale: A (`OrderLine`) and B (`Order`) do not represent the same business concept; instead, they have a part-whole relationship. In `src/ordering/domain/order.ts` (node `99595122f2958507`), `Order` holds a collection of `OrderLine` instances (`readonly lines: readonly OrderLine[],`) where each `OrderLine` represents an individual line item with `price` and `quantity` (`return this.lines.reduce((acc, l) => acc + l.price * l.quantity, 0);`). In `src/notifications/application/order-notification.service.ts` (node `ee110f001f97012a`), `OrderNotificationService` uses the whole `Order` concept and calls its aggregate method (`const subtotal = order.subtotal();`).
